definitions.explanation: What remains after something has passed or ended; vestiges of the past.

definitions.gloss: reluctance to part; attachment at parting
definitions.explanation: The feeling of sadness or reluctance when separating from someone or something.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}の{名残|なごり}がまだ{残|のこ}っている。
この{建物|たてもの}には{昔|むかし}の{名残|なごり}がある。
examples.english: This building has remnants of the past.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{名残|なごり}で{風|かぜ}がまだ{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: The wind is still strong as a lingering effect of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {城跡|しろあと}に{戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}の{名残|なごり}を{見|み}ることができる。
examples.english: You can see remnants of the Warring States period at the castle ruins.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{名残|なごり}を{惜|お}しみながら、{最後|さいご}の{花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: Savoring the last traces of summer, we enjoyed the final fireworks festival.

examples.japanese: {名残|なごり}{惜|お}しいが、そろそろ{帰|かえ}らなければ。
examples.english: I'm reluctant to leave, but I must go soon.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}の{後|あと}、{名残|なごり}を{惜|お}しんで{友達|ともだち}と{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}り{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: After the graduation ceremony, reluctant to part, we kept taking photos with our friends.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}{先|さき}での{生活|せいかつ}が{名残|なごり}{惜|お}しくて、なかなか{飛行機|ひこうき}に{乗|の}る{気|き}になれなかった。
examples.english: I was so reluctant to leave my life studying abroad that I could hardly bring myself to get on the plane.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れの{名残|なごり}{惜|お}しさに、{駅|えき}のホームでいつまでも{手|て}を{振|ふ}っていた。
examples.english: Reluctant to say goodbye, we kept waving on the station platform for the longest time.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {波|な}{残|ごり} (waves remaining) - originally the traces left on the shore after waves recede.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{名残|なごり}{惜|お}しい (reluctant to part, sad to leave)
・{名残|なごり}の{雪|ゆき} (lingering snow of late winter)
・{名残|なごり}を{惜|お}しむ (to be reluctant to part)
・{冬|ふゆ}の{名残|なごり} (remnants of winter)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{名残|なごり} evokes a poetic sense of transience and the bittersweet feelings associated with endings. It's often used in seasonal references ({名残|なごり}の{桜|さくら}, the last cherry blossoms).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{面影|おもかげ} (traces, vestiges) - focuses on visual memory or resemblance
・{名残|なごり} - broader, includes physical traces and emotional attachment
